changes.summary: Retained-power window after ignition off extended from 45 s to 60 s (door-open cut-off unchanged).
Trigger changed from rain sensor to the CAN request WLC_CloseAll from the body controller; behaviour now defined as express close with anti-pinch active instead of vague 'quickly'.
Pinch detection force threshold lowered from 100 N to 80 N.
Minimum reversal distance increased from 125 mm to 150 mm (or fully open); 10 ms stop time unchanged.
Wording only: 'set itself to not normalized' became 'set its state to not normalized'; 500 ms condition and behaviour unchanged.
Made quantitative: limit is now 130 °C estimated temperature and current is limited to 15 A (was 'limit' and 'safe value').
WLC_Status period shortened from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms; content unchanged.
Requirement now only covers storing B1A02 (25 A, 50 ms); the motor-stop and fault-state reactions were split out into new WLC-037 and WLC-038.

tests.reason: Remove trace to deleted WLC-032; the test stays because it still verifies WLC-004, but confirm its 100 µA limit matches WLC-004's current text (see concerns).

tests.new_pass_criteria: Movement at 50 s; no movement at 70 s (window retained for 60 s); no movement after a front door is opened at 10 s. Also remove the trace to deleted WLC-023.
tests.reason: The retained-power time changed from 45 s to 60 s so the old sample times of 40 s and 50 s no longer bracket the limit, and the trace to deleted WLC-023 must be dropped.

tests.new_pass_criteria: With the window half open, on receipt of CAN request WLC_CloseAll the window closes fully in express mode; a pinch obstacle placed in the pinch zone during this close is detected and reversed (anti-pinch active). Rain signal alone does not trigger the close.
tests.reason: The trigger and behaviour changed from a rain signal to CAN WLC_CloseAll with express close and anti-pinch, so the stimulus and criteria must be rewritten (and the test retitled).

tests.new_pass_criteria: Motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 80 N; reversal of at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
tests.reason: Both the force threshold (100 to 80 N) and the reversal distance (125 to 150 mm) changed.
Pass criteria are 'as TC-AP-01' so they inherit the new 80 N and 150 mm limits; the test must be run again at 9.0 V.
Pass criteria are 'as TC-AP-01' so they inherit the new limits; rerun at 16.0 V.
Inherits the new limits from TC-AP-01; this is the cold plus low-voltage worst case for stop time, so rerun it first and on every software release (LL-2022-02).
Inherits the new 80 N and 150 mm limits from TC-AP-01; rerun at 85 °C.

tests.new_pass_criteria: No false pinch detection and no false reversal on the rough-road vibration profile with the 80 N threshold (re-trace to WLC-014); stop time still within 10 ms on a real pinch under vibration.
tests.reason: Remove the trace to deleted WLC-018, but keep and rerun the test: the lower 80 N threshold raises false-reversal risk and LL-2021-07 requires re-checking it.
WLC-021 changed only in wording; the 500 ms condition and the test are unaffected.

tests.new_pass_criteria: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, motor current is limited to 15 A (measured current does not exceed 15 A after the limit is reached).
tests.reason: The requirement now gives a specific 130 °C trigger and a 15 A limit, so 'Motor current reduced' is no longer sufficient.

tests.new_pass_criteria: Period 50 ms ± 5 ms; all four signals (window position, movement state, normalization state, fault state) present; no missed frames, also under worst-case bus load.
tests.reason: The WLC-028 cycle time changed from 100 ms ± 10 ms to 50 ms ± 5 ms.

tests.new_pass_criteria: With 27 A applied for 100 ms, B1A02 is stored. B1A02 is not stored for a current below 25 A or for a duration shorter than 50 ms. Motor stop and fault state in WLC_Status are checked here for WLC-037 and WLC-038.
tests.reason: WLC-030 now only covers DTC storage; the stop and fault-state checks move to the traces of WLC-037/038, and negative cases around the 25 A and 50 ms limits should be added.
It traces only to deleted WLC-033, which was subjective and untestable, so it verifies nothing in the new version (retire the test, but see concerns about a usability review).

added.extend_test: New test needed (e.g. TC-AP-10); TC-AP-08 (repeated pinch lockout) is related but verifies a different behaviour, so do not stretch it.
added.pass_criteria: After a pinch reversal, an express close request made before 2 s has elapsed is not executed; an express close request made after 2 s is executed. Check with margin on each side of 2 s (e.g. 1.5 s and 2.5 s) and clarify with the requirement owner whether manual close is still allowed during the inhibit.
After B1A02 is stored (27 A for 100 ms, window blocked), the motor is stopped and stays stopped. The requirement gives no timing, so ask for a limit.
After B1A02 is stored, the fault state signal in WLC_Status is set in the next WLC_Status frame (50 ms ± 5 ms period) and the other three signals are still present.

concerns.concern: WLC-032 (sleep current below 100 µA) was deleted, but TC-PW-04 still traces to WLC-004. Confirm that WLC-004 states the sleep current limit. If not, deleting WLC-032 left a hardware-relevant requirement unverified, and the deletion should be checked as possibly unintended.
Pinch protection in manual and express mode (WLC-016) does not trace to a changed requirement, but it depends on the 80 N threshold and 150 mm reversal. Rerun it.
Repeated pinch lockout (WLC-019) uses reversals, so it is affected by the new 80 N and 150 mm limits and by the new 2 s express close inhibit (WLC-039). Rerun and check for interaction.
Climatic operation (WLC-035) probably includes pinch behaviour. Rerun it to check the 80 N threshold and 150 mm reversal across the climate range.

LL-2022-02: cold plus low voltage is the worst case for stop time. Run TC-AP-04 first, with the new 80 N threshold, and on every software release. Also repeat the vibration check together with the stop-time check (LL-2021-07), because the threshold changed.

LL-2021-07: any change to the force threshold needs a new check of both false reversals and stop time. Run TC-AP-09 on vibration and keep it. Add a cold/low-voltage vibration case, and trace it to WLC-014.

LL-2024-01: the 130 °C limit check relies on the thermal estimate, so make sure the estimate is current. The platform thermal module is shared with WLC-200, so verify that the fix is present in the build under test. Also review TC-TH-01, TC-TH-03 and TC-TH-04, which use the limit and may carry old values.

LL-2024-09: when the cycle time goes from 100 ms to 50 ms, repeat the worst-case queue calculation. Test WLC_Status timing under worst bus load including diagnostic sessions, not only on a quiet bus. WLC_CloseAll reception adds load.

Express close only when normalized (WLC-013/017): WLC-012 now calls for an express close on WLC_CloseAll, which may conflict with the not-normalized restriction. Clarify the behaviour when not normalized and test it. Check TC-AP-07 as well.

The rain-triggered close has gone from this controller's requirements. Confirm the rain function now lives in the body controller or system requirements and is verified there. Add a WLC_CloseAll test with anti-pinch active.
Diagnostic response time (WLC-031) may involve the motor stop on overcurrent, which has moved to WLC-037. Check its trace and timing. WLC-037 also has no stop-time limit, so ask for one.

The usability review is retired for traceability, but a usability review has value beyond the requirement (switch feel, response). Consider keeping it as a non-traced evaluation, or replace WLC-033 with measurable requirements.
With a 150 mm reversal and a rod at 100 mm, check that the setup gives enough travel to tell a 150 mm reversal from 'fully open'. Otherwise the new limit may be passed trivially.

LL-2023-05: every sensor needs a plausibility check with a timeout, and a sensor-removal test at the lowest supply voltage. The Hall sensor loss test is not traced to a change, but confirm it still runs at the lowest voltage with the new threshold and reversal behaviour.

added.WLC-039: After a pinch reversal, express close shall be inhibited for 2 s.
added.WLC-037: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall stop the motor.
added.WLC-038: When diagnostic trouble code B1A02 is stored, the controller shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.

deleted.WLC-018: The anti-pinch function shall be robust against all disturbances.
deleted.WLC-023: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s.
deleted.WLC-032: In sleep mode, the controller shall draw less than 100 µA from the 12 V supply.
deleted.WLC-033: The controller shall be user friendly.
deleted.WLC-034: The software shall be developed according to the company software process.

WLC-007.old: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 45 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.
WLC-007.new: After ignition off, the controller shall allow window movement for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first.

WLC-012.old: The window shall close quickly when the rain sensor reports rain.
WLC-012.new: When the body controller sends the CAN request WLC_CloseAll, the controller shall close the window in express mode, with anti-pinch protection active.

WLC-014.old: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 100 N.
WLC-014.new: While closing in the pinch zone, the controller shall detect a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N.

WLC-015.old: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 125 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.
WLC-015.new: On a detected pinch, the controller shall stop the motor within 10 ms and reverse the window by at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less.

WLC-021.old: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set itself to not normalized.
WLC-021.new: After a supply interruption longer than 500 ms, the controller shall set its state to not normalized.

WLC-025.old: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds the limit, the controller shall reduce motor current to a safe value.
WLC-025.new: When the estimated motor temperature exceeds 130 °C, the controller shall limit motor current to 15 A.

WLC-028.old: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 100 ms ± 10 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.
WLC-028.new: The controller shall send the CAN message WLC_Status every 50 ms ± 5 ms with window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state.

WLC-030.old: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms and shall stop the motor and shall set the fault state in WLC_Status.
WLC-030.new: The controller shall store diagnostic trouble code B1A02 when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms.
